files.tests/test_textutil.py:
from app.textutil import slugify

def test_slugify():
    assert slugify("Hello wORLD") == "hello-world"
    assert slugify("This is a test") == "this-is-a-test"
    assert slugify("12345") == "12345"
    assert slugify("   Leading and trailing spaces   ") == "leading-and-trailing-spaces"
    assert slugify("No special characters") == "no-special-characters"
    assert slugify("Special characters!@#$%^&*()_+") == "special-characters"
    assert slugify("") == ""
